title: [Control Systems] Siemens security advisory (AV26-881)
description: As of September 3, 2026, Siemens is affected by a vulnerability in the following products:
products:
Mendix SAML (Mendix 10 compatible)
	Prior to V4.2.3

Mendix SAML (Mendix 11 compatible)
	Prior to V4.2.3

Mendix SAML (Mendix 9.24 compatible)
	Prior to V3.6.27
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
